description:
Is a US street address in a USDA Rural Development eligible area (the property-location test for USDA Single
        Family Housing Direct and Guaranteed loans, Section 502, and Multifamily Housing)? Give a full street address with
        city and state. Locates the address, then checks the point against USDA's official
        ineligible-area map layer (the one USDA's own Property Eligibility map uses). Returns eligible true/false, the
        matched address and county. NOT an official USDA determination (Rural Development decides on a complete
        application) and location only: household income limits (USDA income tool linked in the answer), credit and loan
        approval are separate. status 'not_determined' means USDA's map service did not answer: never read it as yes or no.
name: usda_eligibility_lookup
